scripts.start:example: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --parallel --filter './examples/*' run dev
scripts.bench: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run bench
scripts.benchmark:baseline: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run snapshot:baseline
scripts.benchmark:check: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run run:check
scripts.benchmark:ci-basic: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run ci-basic
scripts.benchmark:compare: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run compare
scripts.benchmark:compare:check: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run compare:check
scripts.benchmark:ecosystem: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run ecosystem
scripts.benchmark:ecosystem:check: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run ecosystem:check
scripts.benchmark:site-isolation: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run site-isolation
scripts.benchmark:rfc-performance: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run rfc-performance
scripts.benchmark:smoke: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run smoke
scripts.benchmark:ssr-streaming: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run ssr-streaming
scripts.benchmark:ssr-streaming:check: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/benchmark run ssr-streaming:check
scripts.build: pnpm -r run build && pnpm run check:lodash-imports
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter './packages/**' run build && pnpm run check:lodash-imports
scripts.prerelease:alpha: changeset pre enter alpha && changeset && pnpm ci:version
scripts.release:alpha: pnpm run build && changeset publish && changeset pre exit
scripts.ci: pnpm run build && pnpm run eslint && pnpm run prettier:check
scripts.test: pnpm run test:release-scripts && pnpm -r run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @qiankunjs/e2e run test:e2e
